% --- palette -------------------------------------------------------------------------
\definecolor{sevCritical}{HTML}{9B1C1C}
\definecolor{sevMajor}   {HTML}{B45309}
\definecolor{sevMinor}   {HTML}{1D4ED8}
\definecolor{sevAdvisory}{HTML}{4B5563}
\definecolor{stFixed}    {HTML}{166534}
\definecolor{stOpen}     {HTML}{9B1C1C}
\definecolor{rule}       {HTML}{D1D5DB}
\definecolor{muted}      {HTML}{6B7280}

% --- badges --------------------------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\badge}[2]{%
  \colorbox{#1}{\textcolor{white}{\footnotesize\bfseries\,#2\,}}}
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\severity}[1]{%
  \def\tmp{#1}%
  \def\critical{critical}\def\major{major}\def\minor{minor}%
  \ifx\tmp\critical\badge{sevCritical}{CRITICAL}\else
  \ifx\tmp\major\badge{sevMajor}{MAJOR}\else
  \ifx\tmp\minor\badge{sevMinor}{MINOR}\else
  \badge{sevAdvisory}{ADVISORY}\fi\fi\fi}
\newcommand{\statebadge}[1]{%
  \def\tmps{#1}%
  \def\fixeds{fixed}\def\opens{open}%
  \ifx\tmps\fixeds\badge{stFixed}{FIXED}\else
  \ifx\tmps\opens\badge{stOpen}{OPEN}\else
  \badge{sevAdvisory}{\MakeUppercase{#1}}\fi\fi}
\makeatother

% --- typography ----------------------------------------------------------------------
\titleformat{\section}{\Large\bfseries}{\thesection}{0.7em}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\normalsize\bfseries}{\thesubsection}{0.6em}{}
\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=1.3em,itemsep=2pt,topsep=3pt}
\setlist[description]{leftmargin=0pt,labelsep=0.6em,itemsep=3pt,topsep=3pt,font=\normalfont\bfseries}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.25}
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{3em}
\newcolumntype{L}[1]{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{#1}}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\fancyhead[L]{\footnotesize\textcolor{muted}{%%HEADER%%}}
\fancyhead[R]{\footnotesize\textcolor{muted}{\thepage}}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}

\newcommand{\finding}[4]{%
  \needspace{5\baselineskip}%
  \phantomsection%
  \subsection*{#1\, ---\, #2}%
  \addcontentsline{toc}{subsection}{\texorpdfstring{#1 --- #2}{#1 - #2}}%
  \nopagebreak\noindent\severity{#3}\hspace{0.4em}\statebadge{#4}\par\smallskip}
